criteria.description: The selected question, collection plan, feasible analysis direction and remaining conditions form a useful prospective plan. No outcome estimate, report artifact or named estimator is mandatory.

Credit only disclosed or otherwise legitimately established facts. Evaluate whether omitted consequential questions materially weaken the advice; do not require the entire book or every core card. A pending unanswered question is not evidence that its answer is unavailable.
Consider a beneficial alternative or changed target when the evidence motivates it, explain its requirements, and preserve user choice. No count of alternatives or fixed method sequence is required.

Each spoken reply is at most 50 words and answers one small question or subquestion, or makes one choice/clarification. Semantic breadth requires reading the actual reply; a single sentence, card ID or question label does not certify one item.

When several requests occur, the actor follows the frozen selection rule, intentionally omits the others publicly and retains them privately. No full-book attachment, source identity or evaluator reasoning is disclosed. If a compound request never occurs, record that stress coverage as unobserved, not a failure.

Replies remain within allowed facts, stable unknowns and decision preferences. Do not invent recruitment, approvals, datasets, results or communication. Actor failures are separate from consultant quality.

Stop at an accepted actionable plan or useful narrower planning conclusion. The private expected duration is descriptive; finishing outside it is not itself a defect. A capacity stop before that useful endpoint is incomplete, and a blanket refusal is not useful completion.

Distinguish a comparison of care received under defined surgical arrangements from an inherent or biological effect of gender. Clarify the relevant clinician or team and retain the connection to the user's original concern when proposing a different actionable question.
criteria.evidence_needed: The initial request exposes the interpretive problem. Judge detailed attribution or category handling against the facts actually disclosed; an unresolved definition may remain an explicit planning question.

criteria.description: Do not infer random assignment from an on-call roster or causal adequacy from a large operation count. A causal route needs a credible account of referral, allocation, takeovers and comparable patients; restrict the target or claim when that account is not yet available.
criteria.evidence_needed: Use revealed allocation and overlap facts, or the consultant's explicit uncertainty and plan to check them. Do not penalize failure to name a hidden takeover mechanism that the actor never disclosed.

criteria.description: Translate the selected question into feasible information priorities and timing: initial allocation and actual care roles, important pre-allocation severity and referral factors, a coherent primary outcome and follow-up, and patient or episode identifiers. Avoid indiscriminately adjusting for postoperative variables. If relevant to the selected outcome, clarify the complication definition and source rather than equating every recorded concern with a confirmed event. Planned procedure detail is not automatically pre-allocation information.
criteria.evidence_needed: Assess the final plan against what has been revealed and the selected target. Do not require every possible variable or demand answers to every omitted question; unresolved requirements should be conditional rather than invented.

criteria.description: If follow-up, linkage or cohort selection becomes relevant, account for incomplete outcome ascertainment and the population actually included. Absence from records or successful telephone contacts must not silently define an event-free cohort or replace the proposed population.
criteria.evidence_needed: Judge concrete missingness claims after f-followup or f-linkage is disclosed, and pathway-selection claims after f-nonoperated is disclosed. A cautious unknown-outcome plan can be acceptable before detailed linkage facts appear.

criteria.description: Fit the proposed collection to authority, workload and participation constraints. Treat voluntary identity information, confidentiality and timely clinical care as substantive design issues. Do not assume management support authorizes records access, compel a binary identity response or claim ethics approval is already granted.
criteria.evidence_needed: Use the disclosed resource, authority and ethics facts. Before disclosure, appropriate conditional wording is sufficient; do not require jurisdiction-specific legal claims or a universal approval checklist.

criteria.description: Tie any analysis recommendation to the selected population, care contrast and identified assumptions. Address service and clinician dependence when appropriate, and do not present matching, adjustment or flexible prediction as automatically removing confounding or creating overlap. If experience is measured, explain whether comparing similar experience changes the target; do not automatically adjust for it or for the completed operation and downstream care.
criteria.evidence_needed: Evaluate methods only when proposed. A conditional family of analyses is acceptable if unresolved facts prevent a unique choice; no named estimator or mandatory sensitivity analysis is required.

criteria.description: Use the small answers the actor provides, preserve unanswered matters as unresolved, and reach a useful collection-and-analysis recommendation without demanding the whole book or repeatedly demanding information already answered, explicitly unavailable or deferred without a new decision-relevant reason. A consequential unanswered question may be revisited. Make clear which attainable check would change the route.
criteria.evidence_needed: Read the actual conversation, including omitted questions and any genuine actor inconsistencies. Success can be a narrower feasible plan or an honest causal limitation; no report artifact, fixed alternative count or predetermined method is necessary.

acceptable_routes.route: Prospective observational cohort restricted to services with comparable patients and sufficiently clear clinician or team attribution, with adjustment or standardization based on pre-allocation information.
acceptable_routes.benefit: Can connect a focused collection plan to the original concern while avoiding comparisons driven entirely by specialty or hospital differences.
acceptable_routes.claim_limit: Conditional on adequate measured confounding control, overlap, measurement and follow-up. It concerns care under the defined arrangements and population; it does not establish an intrinsic causal effect of gender or guarantee that every service can be compared.

acceptable_routes.route: Narrow the study to an actionable allocation, communication or support practice after defining what the practice is and how its variation and implementation can be observed.
acceptable_routes.benefit: May produce a more directly useful hospital decision when broad identity-group comparisons lack interpretable allocation or common support.
acceptable_routes.claim_limit: This changes the question and may require new measurements or permissions. The current book contains no established causal design for a specific practice, so the consultant must keep this proposal conditional rather than assert it is already identified.

acceptable_routes.route: Begin with a limited approved feasibility audit and a prospectively specified descriptive or risk-adjusted association study, retaining a conditional causal upgrade only if allocation, overlap and outcome ascertainment prove adequate.
acceptable_routes.benefit: Produces an achievable collection plan and useful evidence about care differences when a credible causal comparison cannot yet be supported.
acceptable_routes.claim_limit: Associations and feasibility findings are not causal conclusions. Restricting a population, omitting difficult follow-up or obtaining a statistically adjusted result must not silently convert this route into a causal one.

route_scoring: Routes are examples, not an exhaustive answer key. Fact references identify relevant evidence, not a mandatory question checklist. Review only the chosen route's material needs. Conditional plans can identify facts to establish later.
failure_examples: Promise a causal estimate merely because the cohort has about 12,000 operations or because many confounders can be included.
Treat on-duty assignment as randomized despite disclosed takeovers and transfers, without investigating allocation.

Use scheduled consultant gender as a proxy for an intended hands-on-operator or supervisor exposure despite unresolved role attribution, without explicitly selecting and defining a different scheduled-care policy target.
Infer gender from names, force everyone into two categories or treat self-described gender as an intrinsic biological treatment.
Adjust for postoperative complications as if they were baseline patient characteristics, without a target-specific justification.
Count patients without a hospital return or successful telephone contact as alive and complication-free.
Recommend changing surgeon assignment, delaying needed surgery or disclosing identifiable performance rankings despite the stated authority and confidentiality constraints.
Demand universal home visits or a long intake assessment after the staffing and budget limits are disclosed.
Reject all useful study planning because identity itself is not a simple intervention, without considering an actionable related question or explicitly noncausal evidence.
Replace unanswered facts with invented audit results, known outcome rates, confirmed approval or an assumption that declined or unavailable information is complete.
completion_signs: The coordinator can explain the proposed population, care comparison and practical decision, with the main causal limitation stated plainly.
The recommendation identifies a short set of collection priorities, their timing and a feasible follow-up approach, rather than demanding all possible confounders.
Analysis is conditional on the actual allocation and comparability evidence, and at least one attainable preparatory check is connected to the decision it could change.
Unanswered questions remain visible where consequential, without requiring the actor to disclose every fact card or complete a report.
The actor has enough guidance to prepare the next practical planning step; if it does not, review identifies the specific unresolved issue that prevented a useful endpoint.
useful_stop: An accepted actionable collection and conditional analysis plan, or a user-chosen narrower planning endpoint with concrete next steps. Blanket refusal or reaching a cap is not useful completion.
duration_rule: Count delivered consultant replies from the first answer to the useful endpoint. The range is descriptive, not a pass threshold or actor instruction. Record the actual count. At the configured ceiling, stop and retain incomplete status if the goal is unmet.
validation_scope: Structural fixture checks and independent review do not prove actor adherence, causal validity or live host qualification.
